en.bdb: If a blind becomes a leader

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਂਸ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਚਰਣੋਦਕ ਬਾਵਨ ਬੋਹਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: vaa(n)s suga(n)dh na hoviee charanodhak baavan bohaae|

en.bdb: Bamboo does not become fragrant but by the wash of Gum's feet, this also becomes possible.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਚਹੁਂ ਕੰਚਨ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਕਚਹੁਂ ਕੰਚਨ ਪਾਰਸ ਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: kachahu(n) ka(n)chan naa theeaai kachahu(n) ka(n)chan paaras laae|

en.bdb: Glass does not become gold but with the impact of philosopher's stone in the form of Guru, glass also transforms into gold.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਿੰਮੁਲ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਕਰਿ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: nihafal si(n)mul jaaneeaai afal safal kar sabh fal paae|

en.bdb: Silk-cotton tree is supposed to be fruitless but that too (by the grace of Guru) becomes fruitful and gives all sorts of fruits.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਉਂ ਨ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਉਜਲੇ ਕਾਲੀ ਹੂੰ ਧਉਲੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: kaau(n) na hovan ujale kaalee hoo(n) dhaule sir aae|

en.bdb: However, manmukhs like crows never change into white from black even if their black hair become white i.e. they never leave their nature even in old age.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਗ ਵੰਸ ਹੁਇ ਪਰਮਹੰਸ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: kaag va(n)s hui paramaha(n)s niramolak motee chun khaae|

en.bdb: But (by the grace of the Gum) the crow changes into swan and picks up invaluable pearls to eat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੋਤਹੁਂ ਦੇਵ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਕਮਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: pasoo parotahu(n) dhev kar saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh kamaae|

en.bdb: The holy congregation transforming beasts and ghosts into gods, causes them to realize the word of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਤੀਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜੇ ਭਾਇ ਲੁਭਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: tis gur saar na jaateeaa dhuramat dhooje bhai lubhaae|

en.bdb: Those wicked ones who are engrossed in the sense of duality have not known the glory of the Guru.
If the leader is blind, his companions are bound to be robbed of their belongings.
